name: IMPA_predict_morphology
description: Generate treated single-cell populations with pretrained IMPA from native 96x96x3 uint8 DMSO controls and Morgan fingerprints. Uses official generator/style mapping and checkpoint-derived Gaussian noise dimension; no resizing. Produces PNGs and a persistent model-independent JSONL image index usable by standalone MoA/FID/KID evaluators. Requires explicit local source, checkpoint, frozen embedding table and fingerprint CSV. No runtime downloads, training, dose/time inference or same-cell causal claims.

control_manifest.description: Control-only CSV with sample_id,image_path,batch,condition. condition must be DMSO. Relative image paths resolve beside the manifest; cells must be HWC uint8 96x96x3 NPY or lossless RGB PNG in official channel order.

compounds.description: Exact compound identifiers in the supplied official 1024-feature embedding CSV. No free-text encoding or dose/time extrapolation.

output_dir.description: Parent directory for a unique run containing PNG predictions, JSONL index, manifest and log.

batch.description: Optional exact control batch filter. Otherwise generate separately for every control batch.

python_executable.description: Python executable in the model environment; defaults to the current interpreter.

device.description: auto selects CUDA when available, otherwise CPU.

samples_per_condition.description: Images per compound per batch. At most 4096 images per call. Controls resampled if necessary.

batch_size.description: Inference minibatch size; reduce for limited memory.

seed.description: Seed for control selection, dequantization and sampling noise.

cpu_threads.description: PyTorch intra-op CPU threads in the isolated worker.

timeout_seconds.description: Worker timeout; a timed-out or failed run is never returned as successful.

checkpoint_path.description: Local released IMPA nets.ckpt. Generator and mapping parameters are loaded strictly; training-only networks are not executed.

embeddings_path.description: Named 1024-feature Morgan fingerprint CSV such as official emb_fp.csv.

embedding_checkpoint.description: Matching released embeddings.ckpt. Frozen rows are matched exactly to named fingerprints to recover training vocabulary.

allow_unseen_compounds.description: Explicitly allow fingerprint-encoded compounds absent from the frozen training vocabulary for OOD experiments. Does not establish predictive validity.
